An '''aerosled''' was a [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Tangan Industries]]. At just over four meters it was one of the smallest airspeeders in production, and its easy-to-store size was one of its major selling points.

It was usually unarmed, but Tangan Industries did produce an armed version for certain clients and for use as internal security.
